text:
mina: quick sync: halcyon7.5b-int6 bring-up. need a 1-paragraph econ summary + single-line GTN recommendation by EOD.

aditya: quick take: ~19% token cost savings vs our int8 baseline, latency slightly improved. some multi-turn factual drift on >6 turns. short ops below.

zephyr: perf numbers (cold-kv): p50 ~85ms, p95 ~160ms on A100s; kv-hit ~28% (no warmstart). throughput ~14 rps/gpu at seq=180.

ellis: quality: single-turn chat & instruction parity; multi-turn long-context (dialogue history > 6 turns) shows reduced persona consistency and a small rise in repeat hallucinations. automated factuality metric down ~2.8 pts vs fp32 on long-dialog slices.

aditya: econ snippet (ballpark):
```
cost_per_token: $0.00068
avg_tokens_per_req: 150
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.10
cost_delta_vs_int8: -19%
```

mina: product wants green/amber/red. one-line rec?

zephyr: amber  route chat, RAG, and low-context tasks. hold long multi-turn assistants and citation-heavy summarizers until we validate priming & short-rescore mitigations.

ellis: ops ask: run 3 canaries: (A) 5% chat warm-kv, (B) 2% multi-turn with priming templates, (C) 0% summarizers. capture decode traces.

canary-bot: scheduled canaries: halcyon7p5b-int6 -> 2026-08-03T14:00Z: A=5% chat (warm-kv=true), B=2% multi-turn priming, C=0% summarizers, region=us-west-2. :white_check_mark:

aditya: GTN blurb suggestion: "Halcyon7.5b-int6 cuts token spend ~19% with comparable short-form quality; recommend amber  enable for chat/RAG and hold heavy multi-turn assistants until priming/rescoring experiments complete."

mina: neat. zephyr/ellis, please attach 6 worst-case decode samples and a 3-test mitigation plan. we'll brief GTN tomorrow. :thumbsup:
